set -eu
cat > /run/[REDACTED].py <<'ANTRIEB_PY_EOF'
import select
import socket

listeners = []
for port in (22, 8080, 8081):
    sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    sock.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
    sock.bind(("0.0.0.0", port))
    sock.listen(8)
    listeners.append(sock)
print("ready ports=22,8080,8081", flush=True)
while True:
    readable, _, _ = select.select(listeners, [], [])
    for sock in readable:
        conn, _ = sock.accept()
        with conn:
            conn.sendall(("accepted-port=%d\n" % sock.getsockname()[1]).encode())

command:
set -eu
ip netns exec antrieb-fwtest python3 - <<'ANTRIEB_TEST_EOF'
import errno
import socket
import time

host = "192.0.2.1"
results = {}
for port in (22, 8080, 8081):
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        with socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=2.0) as sock:
            reply = sock.recv(128).decode().strip()
        results[port] = ("accepted", reply, time.monotonic() - started)
    except OSError as exc:
        results[port] = ("rejected", "%s errno=%s" % (exc.__class__.__name__, exc.errno), time.monotonic() - started)

for port in (22, 8080, 8081):
    outcome, detail, elapsed = results[port]
    print("tcp/%d outcome=%s detail=%s elapsed=%.3fs" % (port, outcome, detail, elapsed))

assert results[22][0] == "accepted" and results[22][1] == "accepted-port=22"
assert results[8080][0] == "accepted" and results[8080][1] == "accepted-port=8080"
assert results[8081][0] == "rejected" and results[8081][2] < 1.0
print("VERDICT: tcp/22 and tcp/8080 accepted; unrelated listening tcp/8081 actively rejected")
ANTRIEB_TEST_EOF
